request: Full PQC integration in isolated worktrees using GPT-6 max
changes: Credentials bind an independent ML-DSA-65 holder key. Issuance verifies both the existing curve proof and a purpose-bound PQ signature over the full request and proof; the hybrid issuer signs the resulting holder binding.

Presentations require a PQ signature over the credential, transaction context, nullifier, both curve announcements/responses and all length-prefixed qualification proof fields. Existing curve equations are independently enforced.

The witness generates holder keys from independent CSPRNG material and zeroizes temporary seeds. Scope rerandomization also creates a fresh holder key. Restoration requires the original independent key; curve scalars alone cannot reconstruct it.

Actual OCLOB, DeFMI reservation and Aethel consumers use the new required fields. Tests reject missing, corrupt and truncated PQ signatures, copied curve secrets with a different holder key, and invalid curve proofs freshly signed by the correct PQ holder.

remaining: P3 remains incomplete: durable encrypted holder-key custody, backup and restore integration, legacy QOMM KYB migration and issuer administration authorization are not completed.
